lines.text: Don't skip class, the quiz is today.

data.define: To miss a class on purpose.

example.text: Don't skip class, the quiz is today.

misuse.text: Don't tell your teacher you plan to 'skip class'.

publish.title: What does "skip class" mean?
publish.value: Skip class = Not go to a class. Example: "Don't skip class, the quiz is today." (casual English).
